pins.title: Child-Led Nature Exploration: What Is the Grown-up’s Role in the Starter Kit?
pins.description: Do I need to know the name of every plant? No. In the printable Starter Kit for ages 6–11, the child leads as the Agent. Grown-ups can ask what caught their eye and look up a discovery together afterwards. Explore the Starter Kit.

pins.title: Nature Colour Hunt for Kids: Find Five Colours Without Picking a Thing
pins.description: How can we do a colour hunt without collecting leaves? Pick five colours, then point to examples in bark, stones, leaves or flowers. Allow 10–15 minutes and finish by comparing your most surprising finds. Try the nature colour hunt.
